text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is no experience with overdose of VANRAFIA. Atrasentan has been given in a single dose up to 139.5 mg and multiple doses up to 40 mg/day in healthy volunteers. Overdose of VANRAFIA may result in headache or vasodilation. In the event of an overdose, standard supportive measures should be taken, as required. Dialysis is unlikely to be effective because atrasentan is highly protein-bound.
